releaseNotesKm: ស្វែងរកឥឡូវរកឃើញគ្រប់យ៉ាង៖ កំណត់ចំណាំ បុណ្យជាតិ ប្រភេទ និងកាលបរិច្ឆេទ។ វាយ ១៥/១ ដើម្បីលោតទៅថ្ងៃនោះ ទាំងលេខខ្មែរ និងឈ្មោះខែជាអក្សរ។ លទ្ធផលបែងចែកជាផ្នែក។
releaseNotesEn: Search used to read the event table and nothing else, so a word in a note, a holiday name, a category or a typed date all came back empty - which looks the same as not having it. It now covers notes, holidays, categories and dates: type 15/1 and it offers to take you there, in Khmer numerals or written month names, following your own date order and showing both readings when a date is ambiguous rather than guessing.
